subject: Request: APAC retail advocate for late-stage Kumo Commerce deal

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 03:12:54 +0000
Subject: Request: APAC retail advocate for late-stage Kumo Commerce deal

Team —

Kumo Commerce (lead by Tom Li) is in final procurement conversations for an omnichannel retail deployment; expected close in ~2 weeks if we can clear a couple of last-mile objections on latency and multi-region failover. Vanessa and I spoke with Tom on Wednesday — they specifically asked for a peer who has production experience with our dedicated capacity in APAC and has run a similar inventory-at-edge architecture.

Can we source a short (20–30 minute) reference call with an APAC-based customer who: 
- Is in retail (preferably omnichannel/warehouse+store)
- Can speak to latency improvements and regional failover during peak traffic
- Is comfortable discussing deployment topology (VPC + Dedicated) but can avoid specifics of contract/pricing

Priority timeline: next week (Mon/Tue) — Tom is in Singapore timezone (SGT). He’s an exec technical buyer so a short, focused call is best.

I put together a one-pager with the ask and suggested prompts (attached). If anyone already has a warm advocate in APAC who fits, please ping me directly. If not, Monica — can you check the advocate roster and see who’s available? Markus / Aditya — any internal relationships you can tap?

Thanks — this is a high-impact late-stage ask.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, APAC Sales
Redwood Inference

+1 on urgency. A couple notes from my side:
- Lumen Retail (UK-based customer we onboarded last year) has APAC points of presence and a small team in SG who were on our dedicated pool for their seasonal spikes. Markus led that rollout — Markus, do you have a contact there?
- If Lumen is sensitive, SoundByte Retail (APAC HQ, Singapore) did a public customer spotlight last quarter on resilient inference; Hannah Cho (their head of platform) was extremely positive and has done calls before. Monica, I remember SoundByte being open to advocate calls if we keep it 30 mins max.

If we can line up Hannah for a short call and keep the agenda tight (intro, 10 minutes on topology + results, 10 minutes Q&A), that should move Tom comfortably. I can join the call to handle procurement/contract questions.

2) Hannah: deployment topology + ops during peak (10 mins)
